Sandbox_KnoxEscapeQuest_Enabled_tooltip: Enables the shared server escape campaign.
Sandbox_KnoxEscapeQuest_InteractionSecon: Real-time duration of every quest interaction. The default is 30 seconds; moving, aiming, or taking damage cancels it.
Sandbox_KnoxEscapeQuest_FinalDefenseHour: Game hours between surface rescue-transmitter activation and rescue arrival. With the current two-hour day length, two hours is about 10 real minutes.
Sandbox_KnoxEscapeQuest_SpawnDefenseWave: Attracts existing zombies and spawns capped defense waves.
Sandbox_KnoxEscapeQuest_BaseWaveZombies_: Base number of zombies spawned in each wave.
Sandbox_KnoxEscapeQuest_ZombiesPerPlayer: Additional zombies for each living online player.
Sandbox_KnoxEscapeQuest_MaximumWaveZombi: Caps each wave to limit multiplayer synchronization load.
